title: Employer console
subtitle: Fund payroll, build reliability
connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to manage payroll.

register.heading: Register your company
register.body: Registration is gated by a Dojang Verified Address, so workers know your vaults are real.
register.gateUnverified: This wallet does not hold a Dojang Verified Address yet.
register.gateHowTo: IMGEUM checks GIWA’s live DojangScroll directly and cannot issue verification itself. Claim yours in the GIWA Playground ("Dojang 발급"), then re-check here.

score.heading: Pay-reliability
score.unratedBody: Settle {{n}} pay periods to earn a rating.

open.heading: Open a wage vault
open.workerNotFound: No active up.id name found. Check the spelling, or paste the worker's 0x address instead.
open.workerInvalid: Enter a full up.id name (worker.up.id) or a 0x wallet address.
open.tokenUnknown: No ERC-20 token answered at this address. Check the address and the network.
open.minPeriod: Pay period must be at least {{count}} day(s) — the contract rejects anything shorter.
open.maxPeriod: Pay period cannot exceed {{count}} day(s) — the contract rejects anything longer.

vaults.heading: Your vaults
vaults.approveHint: Token vaults take two transactions: approve the vault to move this amount, then fund it.

arrears.heading: Arrears recorded against you
arrears.body: Public evidence records anyone has filed against your company. They are permanent and cannot be removed — settling the outstanding amount is what changes the picture.
arrears.none: No arrears have been recorded against you.
